status: Implemented local production workflow; AWS/host deployment measurements are external acceptance gates.

sets.P: confirmed paid registration units, independent of attendance
sets.O_p: legal one-seat or approved two-seat options for p

rank_mapper.algorithm: Keep full order; remove disabled; compact active ranks. No renormalization.

parameters.seat_order: (row_number - 1) * seats_per_row + priority_rank; ranks unique per row, lower is better

variables.z[p,o]: Boolean registration p selects option o
variables.boundary[g]: Integer row boundary between consecutive contribution groups within one tier
variables.tier_boundary[t]: Integer seat-order boundary between consecutive nonempty tiers
variables.best[p]: sum(min(seat_order(s) for s in o) * z[p,o])
variables.worst[p]: sum(max(seat_order(s) for s in o) * z[p,o])

hard_constraints.C1: For each eligible p: sum_o z[p,o] = 1. No variables for ineligible registrations.
hard_constraints.C2: For each physical s: occ[s] <= 1, including both seats of Emperor options.
hard_constraints.C3: Blocked seats are absent from all O_p.
hard_constraints.C4: Input schema and semantics validate unique coordinates/IDs, bounds, sides and row indices; candidates reference supplied physical seats only.
hard_constraints.C5: Only CONFIRMED paid registrations are allocated. Attendance never changes eligibility or paid demand.
hard_constraints.C10: Every Emperor registration always occupies one approved adjacent same-row two-seat pair. Both seats retain its display name.
hard_constraints.C11: Approved pairs do not straddle the centre aisle; physical positions define adjacency.
hard_constraints.C12: For higher-tier p and lower-tier q: worst[p] < best[q]. Consecutive nonempty tier boundaries enforce this transitively, including BOTH Emperor seats. Shared rows permitted; accessibility has no exemption.
hard_constraints.C13: Same tier and contribution[p] > contribution[q] imply row[p] <= row[q]. Consecutive within-tier contribution-group row boundaries implement this.
hard_constraints.C15: Both modes: row occupancy equals min(remaining physical demand, available row capacity), front to back.
hard_constraints.C16: Both modes: occ[later] <= occ[earlier] over available seats ordered right/east outward, then left/west outward. Every assignable east seat must be occupied before any west seat in the same row.
hard_constraints.C17: Accessible single must occupy an approved side position; accessible pair must have both seats accessible. This never becomes a configurable preference.

C6.common_desirability: d_o = 2*mean(priority_rank(s)-1 for s in o); integer for one-seat and two-seat options
C6.note: Contribution importance is a soft preference within the hard feasible set. Cross-tier priority is enforced only by C12, independently of preferences.

C8.unit: per registration mean, not double the influence for an Emperor pair

soft_constraints.normalization: N(raw,max)=floor((200*raw+max)/(2*max)); max is clamped to at least 1
soft_constraints.all_off: Weighted cost is zero; hard constraints and canonical selection remain.

proof_and_canonicalization.budget: One shared deadline across construction, weighted objective and canonical passes.
proof_and_canonicalization.stage_fixing: Only fix a stage objective after OPTIMAL. Stop with incumbent on FEASIBLE or later timeout; no claim about unreached stages.
proof_and_canonicalization.canonicalization: After all business objectives proven and fixed, sort participant IDs and minimize each selected option index in sequence. Sort options by stable seat IDs. Fix each index only after optimal proof.
proof_and_canonicalization.completion: canonicalization_complete is true only when all passes finish. OPTIMAL describes business objectives; canonical completion is separate.
proof_and_canonicalization.strict_mode: require_optimal=true rejects unproven business objectives; production default accepts independently valid FEASIBLE.

independent_validation: Reconstruct assignments, physical rules, metrics and stage values from source_request, independently of CP-SAT internals.
lifecycle: Generate private draft -> edit/save revision -> safeguard check -> resolve or acknowledge findings -> explicit atomic publication. Publication rechecks persisted placements and expected public pointer; structural validity and complete paid allocations are mandatory; OPEN C12/C13 findings block, while C15/C16 are advisory.

paid_seat_retention.attendance: Not a solver or workspace field; cannot release seats or replace names.
paid_seat_retention.manual_work: Whole-registration moves/swaps and temporary docking; all paid units must be seated before publication.
paid_seat_retention.regeneration: Changed preference priority/enabled flags produce a private draft with the same paid registrations.
